open_items.title: Sentry passively exports ?assignee=<userId>
open_items.detail: apps/web/src/instrument.ts runs browserTracing + replay at replaysSessionSampleRate 0.1 with zero beforeSend/beforeBreadcrumb, so ~10% of sessions ship filter params to Sentry with no user action. sendDefaultPii: false does NOT strip query strings.
open_items.remedy: Add a beforeSend/beforeBreadcrumb in instrument.ts that scrubs filter params from URLs.
open_items.blocked_by: allowlist - instrument.ts is not among the 15 permitted globs. Blocked by scope, not difficulty. Verified clean at closeout.
